AI Overview
Acceleration City is a free, browser-based 3D racing, stunt, and STEM coding game developed through a collaboration between Carnegie Mellon University and the Boys and Girls Clubs of Western Pennsylvania. 
CS-STEM Network
 +1
Key Features
CoBot Companion: Every vehicle features a personal robotic helper that can be programmed using logic or keybinds to drop ramps, platforms, and boost pads across the world.
Open-World Exploration: Drive through a futuristic neon city, skyscraper rooftops, and desert dunes to collect hidden "Minanimals" and complete stunt challenges.
Vehicle Roster: Choose from 12 distinct vehicles ranging from the high-speed Super Car (top speed of 500 km/h) to specialized rides like the Magic Carpet for floating over terrain or the Jeep for steep off-road climbs.
Controls: Steer with WASD or Arrow keys, jump or use handbrakes with the Spacebar, trigger nitro boosts with Left Shift, and reset your position with R.
